# Test command validation

# Test create command validation
! exec ./nlm_test create
stderr 'usage: nlm create <title>'

# Test rm command validation  
! exec ./nlm_test rm
stderr 'usage: nlm rm \[flags\] <notebook-id>'

# Test sources command validation
! exec ./nlm_test sources
stderr 'usage: nlm sources \[flags\] <notebook-id>'

# Test add command validation - no args
! exec ./nlm_test add
stderr 'usage: nlm add \[flags\] <notebook-id> <source\.\.\.>'

# Test add command validation - one arg
! exec ./nlm_test add notebook123
stderr 'usage: nlm add \[flags\] <notebook-id> <source\.\.\.>'

# Test rm-source command validation
! exec ./nlm_test rm-source
stderr 'usage: nlm rm-source \[flags\] <notebook-id> <source-id\|-\|a,b,c>'

# Test rm-source command validation - one arg
! exec ./nlm_test rm-source notebook123
stderr 'usage: nlm rm-source \[flags\] <notebook-id> <source-id\|-\|a,b,c>'

# Test rename-source command validation
! exec ./nlm_test rename-source
stderr 'usage: nlm rename-source <source-id> <new-name>'

# Test rename-source command validation - one arg

stderr 'usage: nlm rename-source <source-id> <new-name>'
